# Pressbooks Self-Publisher

> Pressbooks is a cloud-based digital publishing platform enabling authors and educators to create, publish, and remix ebooks and open educational resources (OER) without technical barriers.

Pressbooks.pub is the hosted platform operated by Book Oven Inc., a Canadian company, providing tools for self-publishing, textbook adaptation, and collaborative content creation. The platform supports multiple authentication methods and offers tiered support options for authors and institutions.

## Key Topics

- Digital Publishing
- Self-Publishing
- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Book Creation
- Textbook Adaptation
- Content Creation
- Author Tools

## Getting Started

- [Pressbooks Self-Publisher – Create Your Digital Book, Your Way](https://pressbooks.pub): Pressbooks homepage showcasing digital publishing platform for self-publishing and OER content creation
- [Help – Pressbooks Self-Publisher](https://pressbooks.pub/help): Help center with user guide, tutorials, webinars, YouTube channel, and community forum

## Authentication & Account Management

- [Sign up for a new account](https://pressbooks.pub/wp-login.php): Account login page with social authentication via Google, Facebook, GitHub, LinkedIn
- [Sign up for a new account](https://pressbooks.pub/wp-signup.php): User registration page with OAuth provider options and password requirements
- [Sign up for a new account](https://pressbooks.pub/auth): Authentication page supporting social login and new user onboarding

## Support & Services

- [Premium Support – Pressbooks Self-Publisher](https://pressbooks.pub/premium-support): Premium support subscription offering H5P, Hypothesis, and Kindle Direct Publishing assistance

## Legal & Policies

- [Terms of Service – Pressbooks Self-Publisher](https://pressbooks.pub/terms-of-service): Legal terms governing Pressbooks platform usage, subscriptions, and ebook publishing
- [Content Guidelines and Moderation Policy – Pressbooks Self-Publisher](https://pressbooks.pub/content-guidelines-and-moderation-policy): Community standards and content moderation guidelines for Pressbooks.pub platform
